acceptanceCriteria: Each profile either plans a --path list with tests, or keeps a typed, documented refusal decided per profile.
body: Residual from V1-2044 (PR #1316, AFP-V0-094..096). `affected --path` combined with --provider, Playwright, --snapshot or --appmap-impact refuses with invalid-arguments (AFP-V0-094 non-goal). Expected: a listed path can be planned under those profiles.
title: affected --path refuses under Playwright, provider, snapshot and AppMap profiles
